title: Disable item pickup
description: Adds a toggleable keybind that disables item pickup.
body:
![Screenshot of text output when toggle key is pressed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6231997762681075e62abc0b9dba30ba0f06fab2.png)

Adds a toggleable keybind that disables/enables item pickup. Notifies you in chat when it is toggled.

Default keybind is L
